edits.current: Contribution base for occupational risk. Same floor and ceiling. Vacation and paid-leave (VAC-LR) days are reported on their own detail record (AT2 v30 §2.1.2.2 b) with the number of days of the change event in the ARL day count (T2R2-038); the days of all records add up to 30 (AT2 v30 §2.1.2.3.13). No occupational-risk contribution is due for enjoyed vacation (VAC-LR = X) (Decreto 1072 de 2015 art. 2.2.4.2.1.6 numeral 1.3; Consejo de Estado, Sección Cuarta, exp. 25958 of 2022); remunerated leave (VAC-LR = L) remains contributory; maternity or paternity leave days (LMA = X) carry no occupational-risk contribution (Decreto 1072 de 2015 art. 2.2.4.2.1.6).
edits.proposed: Contribution base for occupational risk. Same floor and ceiling. Vacation and paid-leave (VAC-LR) days are reported on their own detail record (AT2 v30 §2.1.2.2 b) with the number of days of the change event in the ARL day count (T2R2-038); the days of all records add up to 30 (AT2 v30 §2.1.2.3.13). No occupational-risk contribution is due for enjoyed vacation (VAC-LR = X) (Decreto 1072 de 2015 art. 2.2.4.2.1.6 numeral 1.3; Consejo de Estado, Sección Cuarta, exp. 25958 of 2022); remunerated leave (VAC-LR = L) remains contributory.

edits.current: UNLIKE THE OTHER CHANGE EVENT FLAGS THIS ONE CARRIES A NUMBER, not an X: it is the count of days of incapacity arising from an occupational accident or disease, funded by the ARL from day one at 100%. Maps to electronic payroll Incapacity with Tipo = 2 or 3.
edits.proposed: UNLIKE THE OTHER CHANGE EVENT FLAGS THIS ONE CARRIES A NUMBER, not an X: it is the count of days of incapacity arising from an occupational accident or disease, paid by the ARL as a subsidy of 100% of the contribution base, from the day after the accident (for an occupational disease, from the day after the incapacity begins) (Ley 776 de 2002 art. 3). Maps to electronic payroll Incapacity with Tipo = 2 or 3.
edits.why: #20: citation added; 'from day one' replaced by the rule as the statute states it (from the day after the accident).
edits.evidence: Ley 776 de 2002 art. 3, as transcribed in Corte Constitucional C-543 de 2007: 'Todo afiliado a quien se le defina una incapacidad temporal, recibirá un subsidio equivalente al cien (100%) de su salario base de cotización, calculado desde el día siguiente el que ocurrió el accidente de trabajo ... Para la enfermedad profesional será el mismo subsidio calculado desde el día siguiente de iniciada la incapacidad' (raw/docs/oficiais/CO/2026-10-22-CorteConstitucional-C-543-2007.htm). The Secretaría del Senado page for Ley 776 could not be fetched (connection refused).

edits.current: Rate for the employee's risk class, EMPLOYER-BORNE IN FULL - there is no employee occupational-risk deduction in Colombia, which is why no electronic payroll element corresponds to it. Initial rates by class: I 0.522%, II 1.044%, III 2.436%, IV 4.350%, V 6.960%, within statutory minimum-maximum ranges of 0.348% to 8.7%. THE CLASS ATTACHES TO THE WORK CENTRE, not to the employer.
edits.proposed: Rate for the employee's risk class, EMPLOYER-BORNE IN FULL (Decreto 1072 de 2015 art. 2.2.4.3.7: 'Los empleadores son responsables del pago de las cotizaciones al Sistema General de Riesgos Laborales') - there is no employee occupational-risk deduction in Colombia, which is why no electronic payroll element corresponds to it. Initial rates by class: I 0.522%, II 1.044%, III 2.436%, IV 4.350%, V 6.960%, within statutory minimum-maximum ranges of 0.348% to 8.7% (Decreto 1772 de 1994 art. 13, compiled in Decreto 1072 de 2015 art. 2.2.4.3.5). THE CLASS ATTACHES TO THE WORK CENTRE, not to the employer: the workers of a work centre may be classified in a risk class different from the rest of the company (Decreto 1072 de 2015 art. 2.2.4.3.9).
edits.why: #20: citations added.
edits.evidence: Decreto 1072 de 2015 arts. 2.2.4.3.5 (table: I 0.348% / 0.522%, II 0.435% / 1.044%, III 0.783% / 2.436%, IV 1.740% / 4.350%, V 3.219% / 6.960%; '(Decreto 1772 de 1994, art. 13)'), 2.2.4.3.7 and 2.2.4.3.9 'Centro de trabajo ... podrán clasificarse los trabajadores de uno o más de ellos en una clase de riesgo diferente' (raw/docs/oficiais/CO/2026-10-13-Decreto-1072-2015-FuncionPublica.html); the 8.7% maximum is the Decreto 1772 art. 13 value already used in Field Options A165-D170 (the maximum column is not legible in the local 1072 copy)
